item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Defines `Event(BaseModel)`, uses `Event` for both `invite(..., event_info: Event)` and `Sig.event_info`, and calls `ReAct` with `event_info=Event(...)`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `DummyLM`; the first response emits `next_tool_args` with `event_info` as a nested dict/JSON-shaped object, not a model instance."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"`DummyLM` drives one tool call, then `finish`, then a final extraction response, matching normal offline `ReAct` flow."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"The tool records `type(event_info).__name__` and `assert seen == ['Event']` proves the runtime tool input is the typed Pydantic object."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"`assert out.trajectory['tool_args_0'] == {...}` proves the stored trajectory preserves the LM-emitted nested dict exactly."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
